messages:
Priya: Morning all
I have a relnotes + changelog draft that needs a final pass before we publish. Couple of migration blurbs and a small snippet fix.
Marco: Ping me the draft link?
Priya: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/branches/relnotes-2642009876 
Aisha: Scanning
Noticed the JS quickstart still uses the default export example. New SDK uses named export `Client`. We should add both examples and a short migration note.
Tom: Good catch. Suggest we add a fenced snippet for both CommonJS and ESM.
Priya: Agree. Marco can you paste the ESM snippet?
Marco: Sure: ```js
import { Client } from '@redwood/sdk'
const client = new Client({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })
```
Aisha: And for CommonJS: ```js
const { Client } = require('@redwood/sdk')
const client = new Client({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })
```
Jordan: Also the changelog has a "Known issue" about deduped embedding results appearing as duplicates in some rerank flows. Is that confirmed?
Priya: Yes, eng-ml reproduced it - it's a boundary condition when two identical short inputs hit the cache at the same time. We should link to internal issue #8120 and provide a temporary note: "Disable prefix caching for exact-match short inputs" as workaround.
Tom: Can you include the exact cache toggle snippet? Ops asked for a copy-paste example.
Priya: Added this under Known Issues: ```yaml
# disable short-prefix caching
cache:
  prefix_length_threshold: 8
```
Marco: One more: I ran the link-checker and it flagged /guides/auth/cli -> 404. Docs Bot, can you re-run on the relnotes branch after fixes?
Docs Bot: Link-check scheduled for branch relnotes-2642009876 
ETA ~3m :gear: 
Aisha: There's also a migration guide section referencing Dedicated routing flags
We should clarify the rollout: note that customers on Dedicated need to set `routing.preview=true` in their config to opt-in.
Priya: I'll add a small paragraph under "Deployment changes" with exact config lines.
Jordan: Marketing asked to soften language on the preview feature. Use "preview (opt-in)" not "beta".
Tom: Small nit: the release bullet about "reduced token cost via batching" should include a link to the Optimize guide. Right now it points to /howto/optimize which 302s to the long form. Maybe point directly to /optimize/batching for clarity.
Marco: Docs Bot link-check results: 1 broken link (/guides/auth/cli) 1 redirect (/howto/optimize -> /optimize/overview). 
Priya: I'll open a redirect PR for /guides/auth/cli -> /guides/auth/command-line. Draft PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/5199 
Aisha: For the release header, should we call out the SDK package min-version for the JS change? I think `@redwood/sdk@^2.0.0` is required.
Priya: Added a migration note: "JS SDK: update to @redwood/sdk >= 2.0.0; see migration guide."
Jordan: Anything else on snippets? I saw an auth example still using long-lived keys. Can we recommend short-lived keys with a link to the token rotation page?
Tom: Yes, swap in the ephemeral token example and add a one-line callout.
Priya: Done. Final checklist: - merge snippet PR (Marco) - redirect PR for CLI (Priya) - caching workaround + known-issue note (added) - link-check pass green (Docs Bot) - marketing sign-off on language (Jordan)
Marco: I can get the snippet PR up in the next 20.
Docs Bot: Link-check complete: 1 broken link remaining (/guides/auth/cli). All other links OK.
Priya: I'll push the redirect PR now.
Aisha: When do we want to publish? End of day preferred by PM.
Jordan: EOD publish OK for marketing if copy remains "preview (opt-in)".
Tom: No engineering blockers.
Priya: Thanks everyone
I'll merge once redirect PR lands and Docs Bot reports green. If anything else pops up, drop here and I'll patch the draft quickly. :rocket:
